# 3 Amigos Taquería

> Taqueria in Bloomington, Indiana. Birria eggrolls, big burritos, stacked tortas and loaded nachos. Come hungry, leave with leftovers.

- Phone: (812) 369-4192
- Address: 340 S Patterson Dr Apt 2101, Bloomington, IN 47404
- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: Street tacos; Tacos, queso and dips; Queso and chips
- Rating: 4.4 from 299 Google reviews
